review_candidates.title: Web Design Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Blue Arc Welds ME (BlueArc) is a specialized welding brand serving the construction, oil and gas, and manufacturing sectors across the Middle East. The company focuses on delivering professional-grade equipment that meets demanding industrial environments. Built on global technology and advanced manufacturing standards, BlueArc products emphasize durability, accuracy, and long-term reliability. The brand is committed to bridging the gap between high-end international technology and local industrial requirements, offering solutions tailored to regional needs. Candidates joining BlueArc will contribute to a growing industrial brand that values innovation and dependable performance. Role Description The Web Design Specialist is a full-time remote role responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining BlueArc’s digital presence. Day-to-day tasks include creating modern, user-friendly website layouts, implementing responsive web design best practices, and collaborating with marketing and product teams to translate brand and business goals into effective online experiences. The specialist will work on front-end development tasks, optimize site performance and accessibility, and ensure consistent visual identity across web pages and digital assets. The role also involves updating content, testing and troubleshooting UI elements, and continuously improving the user experience based on analytics and stakeholder feedback. Qualifications Strong skills in Web Design and Responsive Web Design to create user-centered, mobile-friendly layouts. Proficiency in User Interface Design to develop intuitive navigation, visual hierarchy, and consistent design systems. Experience in Front-End Development (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to implement and maintain website features. Graphic Design capabilities to produce and optimize visual assets, icons, banners, and other digital creatives. Familiarity with design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) and basic SEO principles. Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines. Relevant experience in B2B or industrial sectors is an advantage; understanding of technical products is a plus. Bachelor’s degree in Web Design, Computer Science, Digital Media, Graphic Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

review_candidates.title: Senior Architecture Bim Technical Office
review_candidates.description: Company Description SCAD is a construction and development group that also incubates companies in manufacturing, mining, sports, and leisure, supported by a strong engineering flagship. The group delivers integrated, turnkey solutions that combine diverse services into a unified experience for clients. SCAD focuses on providing premium, high-performing shared services and solutions to regional and domestic markets. The organization emphasizes synergy across its business units to achieve superior project fulfillment and long-term client partnerships. Role Description The Senior Architecture BIM Technical Office role is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo, Egypt. This role involves leading and coordinating BIM production for architectural projects, including model setup, development, and maintenance according to company standards and project requirements. The position requires preparing and reviewing architectural drawings, details, and documentation, as well as ensuring integration with other disciplines and alignment with project specifications and codes. Daily tasks include collaborating with design and engineering teams, resolving technical issues, supporting solution architecture and integration efforts, and contributing to continuous improvement of BIM workflows and technical office procedures. The role also involves mentoring junior team members, supporting quality control processes, and participating in project meetings and design reviews. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Architecture and Architectural Design skills, with experience in complex building projects and technical detailing. Candidates should possess Solution Architecture and Integration skills, enabling effective coordination between BIM models, systems, and multidisciplinary teams. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with stakeholders, present technical information clearly, and document work accurately. Proficiency with BIM software (such as Revit, Navisworks, or similar tools) and familiarity with CAD platforms and common data environments. Solid understanding of building codes, standards, and best practices relevant to architectural design and construction. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Architecture or a closely related field, with several years of experience in a technical office or BIM-focused role. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Experience in large-scale, multidisciplinary construction or development projects in the region is an advantage.

Access to the latest networking technologies and hardware platforms. Team-building and company events. Informal and collaborative working environment. Modern office with excellent transport accessibility.
